observation: The durable authority packet's input_corpus_manifest covered only fixtures/postgres even though the repository also contained conformance and adversarial specimens required for evidence-first review.
affected_invariant: Every fixture byte used or available to the rehearsal corpus must be digest-bound, while expected outcomes remain undisclosed to the independent reviewer.
correction: Changed the runner corpus root to fixtures/, recursively hash every fixture file, and emit a versioned structured manifest containing source digests and undisclosed case identifiers without embedding expected answers.
regression_assertion: A durable packet must include every file under fixtures/ in evidence_hashes and source_digests; the offline verifier must resolve all of them from the packet's repository commit.
